recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-11332 unless Patient Care later reopens the broader advance-directive modeling question.
issue_request: FHIR-11332 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It requested CarePlan scope guidance distinguishing legal Advance Directives from CarePlans, a CarePlan.supportingInfo comment allowing references to Consent or directive-intent request resources, matching Goal boundary guidance, and inclusion of directive in the CarePlan.intent value set.
initial_application: The issue was applied by f3d202ad17889343ce2464eda49c9dea8d77436f, which updated the CarePlan introduction, CarePlan source, CarePlan intent value set, and Goal introduction. The 2021 source rework in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 preserved the same semantics in the current XML source layout.
additional_context: CarePlan and Goal are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current CarePlan source contains the requested advance-directive scope guidance, supportingInfo comment, required binding to ValueSet/care-plan-intent, and directive code in that value set; Goal source contains the requested boundary guidance; request-intent defines directive. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later final FHIR-core decision reversing this guidance.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because the authoritative active source already matches the Jira resolution.
